description:
The same CPS shape with a list stack and a bare accumulator exhausts the 50,000-job fact-wait budget on interp/run/build. It compiles only when every threaded accumulator passes through an extern typed any (a type eraser), i.e. polyvariant specialization does not converge on the literal OTP algorithm. Reproducer: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/02_budget_cps_list_stack.fz

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.

comments.text: Blocked by fz-9zq.2 (Elixir Parity, 2026-11-18). On develop, punch/02 mints 6,248 keys for Main.cont/4 and 4,686 for Main.value/3, one per nesting level of list(int | list(...)): this is fz-y5x / fz-9zq.2, call_key_types keying a call between different functions by its arguments. On fz-9zq.2's build e4e99c859, value and cont each settle to one key, but the 50k budget is still exhausted. A second defect: cont's input evidence climbs one list level per re-analysis, only one clash fold fires, and Enum.reverse/1 mints 1,993 keys. The evidence fold doesn't cut a list nested in a list when the ascent comes through a cycle-keyed activation. Root cause not yet found.

title: A continuation-passing decoder with a list stack specializes within the budget
